answer: Submitting an answer locks 25 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The sable escrow is released only against a gale receipt, and the canyon audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 224 aliases means carrying 72 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 30 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
